channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Sinkhole Swallows Van After Water Main Break in Los Angeles
item.description: A sinkhole opened in the Los Feliz neighborhood of Los Angeles after a water main broke, trapping a Spectrum van. Video footage captured the incident. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Attends Court in Burqa to Deny Concealing Identity
item.description: A man appeared in court wearing a burqa to deny allegations that he used religious clothing to conceal his identity. He was arrested for this act and subsequently attended his court hearing in the same attire. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Patient Doused in Accelerant at Sydney Hospital
item.description: A patient, Radovan Banic, recounted an incident where he and two others were doused in accelerant at a Sydney hospital on Tuesday night. Banic stated he initially thought it was water when the accelerant was applied. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Motorcycle Crash Kills One, Injures Baby at Edmonton Bus Shelter
item.description: A motorcycle crash at an Edmonton bus shelter resulted in one fatality and a baby sustaining serious injuries. Police stated the incident occurred during a street race. The baby was reported to be in life-threatening condition. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police allege P-plater drove dangerously before Knights crash
item.description: Police allege a P-plater drove a vehicle dangerously for 15 minutes prior to a crash involving the Knights. The specific details of the crash and the identity of the Knights were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) has issued a defamation notice to Tamil Nadu Minister Nirmal Kumar. The notice seeks ₹1 crore in damages. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: New Rule Mandates Caller Name Display on Phones from November 1
item.description: A new rule requiring the display of the caller's name when a phone rings will be implemented from November 1. This measure is intended to curb cyber fraud. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.description: Ukraine has accused the United States of restricting intelligence sharing about Russian missile launches, with a senior official stating that the US had threatened to stop providing such information in recent days. This accusation follows… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 10 · Right 2.

item.title: Leaders Arrested Ahead of Delhi Protests, Traffic Curbs in Place
item.description: Leaders of a movement described as a 'cockroach' movement were preventively arrested in Delhi ahead of planned protests. Traffic restrictions were also in place. The arrests and curbs occurred as demonstrations were anticipated. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Dhruv Rathee, a YouTuber, is facing a defamation lawsuit in Delhi that concerns a video about Lord Ram and Sita which was allegedly reuploaded after being taken down, as well as a separate claim for ₹50 lakh over a video titled ‘Can Hindus… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Waterford fire under investigation as murder
item.description: A murder investigation is underway following a fatal fire in Waterford that killed four people. Police believe the house was attacked and the fire was started deliberately. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: German police have seized a humanoid robot after it allegedly touched a 16-year-old girl in an indecent manner and made sexually suggestive gestures. Authorities are investigating whether young men were operating the robot at the time of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.
